messages:
sam_ae: Dropping the Orion Health penetration artifacts + external vuln scan into S3: s3://redwood-sec/orion/2026-12-01/pen-test.zip
sam_ae: Customers asks for remediation timeline + owner assignments and verification steps — need this back by EOD Thu (Dec 3).

devops_scan_bot: Automated upload complete: orion-external-scan-2026-12-01.json
devops_scan_bot: Download: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-sec/orion/2026-12-01/pen-test.zip ./` — sha256 checksums included inside archive.

mike_security: I'll triage the webapp findings (auth bypass, XSS). @julia_engineering can you take the RCE / PoC repro?
mike_security: Also flagging possible PII exposure on endpoint `/api/patients/export` — need confirmation.

julia_engineering: On it. Will repro on the dev cluster today. Which git tag matches their POC env?

sam_ae: Use `orion-release/2026-11-15` — that's what they gave us for the POC.

luis_se: Initial remediation ETA proposal:
- High: 3 business days
- Medium: 10 business days
- Low: next sprint
Proposed owners:
- High -> @julia_engineering
- Medium -> @kevin_infra
- Low -> customer ops (with our guidance)

anna_sales: Heads up — Orion needs a formal CSV-style timeline and a signed attestation for their vendor risk team. Can we produce that as part of the bundle?

kevin_infra: Taking infra misconfigs (open buckets, weak IAM perms). I'll push a bucket policy change today and run verification tomorrow AM.

mike_security: Requirements for customer deliverable (from vendor-risk checklist):
- remediation plan per finding
- PO/PR links or patch diffs
- test/verification steps
- evidence (screenshots/logs/sha256)

luis_se: Example checksum block we'll include in the bundle:
```
pen-test.zip.sha256: 3f2a9e6b7c8d4f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5
orion-external-scan.json.sha256: 9b8c7d6e5f4a3b2c1d0e9f8a7b6c5d4e3f2a1b0c9d8e7f6a5b4c3d2e1f0a9b8
```

sam_ae: I'll compile the CSV + attestation template and send the draft to legal + security before sharing with Orion. Target delivery Thu 18:00 PT.

devops_scan_bot: Vulnerability summary: Critical: 0, High: 2, Medium: 6, Low: 12 — full findings attached to S3.

mike_security: Created triage sheet and JIRA tickets:
- PROJ-4523 (High) - auth bypass
- PROJ-4524 (High) - RCE
- PROJ-4525..4530 (Medium)
I'll tag owners and ETA in the sheet.

julia_engineering: Repro complete for RCE (CWE-94), PoC attached in the folder. Opened PR here: https://github.com/orion-health/app/pull/512 — waiting review.

kevin_infra: Bucket policy updated, removed public list grants. Quick test shows no public ACLs: `aws s3api get-bucket-acl --bucket orion-data` -> no PUBLIC grants. :white_check_mark:

sam_ae: Thanks everyone — if we hit any blockers ping me. I'll assemble final bundle (reports, CSV timeline, PR links, checksums, verification steps) and upload to the customer folder.

anna_sales: I'll schedule a 30-min readout with Orion's risk team for Fri morning. Please have the CSV and attestation ready before then.

mike_security: Noted. Will attach remediation verification log files once tests complete.

luis_se: If anything slips, propose fallback: offer 1-week phased commitment with weekly verification reports to satisfy their compliance team.

sam_ae: Agreed. Thanks team :thumbsup:
